component.name: ReolinkLinux
component.summary: Watch, control and record Reolink cameras and NVRs

description.p: A native Linux client for Reolink PoE cameras, NVRs and Home Hubs. It shows every camera in full quality with hardware-accelerated decoding, controls pan, tilt, zoom, presets, patrols and auto tracking, plays back and downloads recordings from the SD card or NVR, and records live video to your computer.
ReolinkLinux is an independent project and is not affiliated with Reolink.
